SoF Tracker 1.47.0

- Real-time HP / MP / EXP bars: Settings > Screen reader > "HP / MP / EXP bars" reads the bars 2, 5, 10 or 20 times a second between full reads (by colour, a few milliseconds each). The dashboard, overlay, phone page and widgets update live, and the low-HP alert reacts within a fraction of a second.
- Full reads can now run every 1 second, or with no pause at all.

SoF Tracker 1.46.0

- Potions per character, read from each character's own setup in the game folder.
- Skill setup panel (Stats tab): skill bar, auto-combat setup and cooldowns, plus stronger skills you can learn now.
- Your own characters are recognised: alts are no longer counted as players met or as danger.
- Game settings check: windowed mode and chat background in the Setup check, and graphics advice when the game freezes.
- Game setting changes are shown on the session timeline.
